name: rewe-shopping
description: Shop at REWE (Germany) for pickup: offers, basket by plain words, earliest pickup slot, recipes to basket, order only after you confirm. Unofficial; runs locally with your own REWE login.

interface.longDescription: Order groceries from REWE for pickup (Abholservice) by chat or voice: see your market's offers, add products in plain words, get the earliest pickup slot, turn REWE recipes into a basket, and place the order only after you confirm total and slot. Uses the open-source rewe-pp-cli from the Printing Press library on your own computer; you log in to REWE yourself in a browser window. Not affiliated with REWE.
